cases.evidence: Probe (Chromium, headless): tab walk = breadcrumb links (1-2), toolbar Bold/Italic/Bulleted list/Insert link (3-6), then #area at stop 7 and stops 8/9/10 all still div#area — forward Tab is trapped. `--key Alt+F10` from #area lands focus on button[aria-label="Bold"], so the advertised exit IS wired (script lines 107-110: `else if (e.altKey && (e.key === 'F10' || e.keyCode === 121)) { e.preventDefault(); firstToolBtn.focus(); }`). BUT `--key Shift+Tab` from #area lands focus on button[aria-label="Insert link"] — because line 104 only intercepts forward Tab: `if (e.key === 'Tab' && !e.shiftKey && !e.altKey)`. Page instruction, lines 70-71: "To move focus out to the toolbar, press <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>F10</kbd> (<kbd>Option</kbd>+<kbd>F10</kbd> on macOS)."
cases.reasoning: Davin's report is factually right about the platform: with macOS's default media-key mapping (F10 = mute), Option+F10 opens the Sound pane of System Settings and the keydown never reaches the browser, so a Mac annotator literally cannot exercise the exit the page advertises — the metadata's claim that it "actually works" is platform-conditional. Probing also turned up a second, larger problem the annotators did not name: Shift+Tab is NOT intercepted and escapes the editing area to the toolbar, so the case's premise in `mechanism` ("The exit is a non-arrow/Tab method, so advice is owed") is contradicted by the shipped page — a standard unmodified key already exits, which is also a divergence from the cited WCAG Understanding WYSIWYG example, where Tab AND Shift+Tab both indent. expected="passed" is very likely still right (no trap exists by any route, and the page mirrors a normative WCAG example), but the repair direction is a real judgment call — intercept Shift+Tab to restore the design intent (page change), rewrite `mechanism`/`scenario` to match the shipped behaviour (metadata change), or add an Esc alternative so the advised exit is reachable on macOS — so this cannot be applied mechanically. groundTruthDisputed=true because Davin recorded issueExists=yes against expected="passed".
